multi-view.$description: MultiView: pages side by side, one in sight, brought by a swipe or from code; the panels of a tab strip without the strip.

gap.$description: Between the views, seen while a finger drags them.

frame.$description: The viewport the views slide in: `swipeable` when a drag moves it, `dragging` while one does.

view.$description: A view, the page in sight or one beside it.
